pages.title: A Better View from Above
pages.text: Craft a mace from a Heavy Core and Breeze Rod and land a real falling smash.

pages.title: A Better View from Above
pages.text: Connect the mace’s rare materials with its actual falling smash.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Dangerous height is unnecessary. Density boosts falling damage, Breach penetrates armor and Wind Burst adds smash-triggered wind. A Breeze Rod separately crafts four Wind Charges.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Core and rod craft the mace; three enchantments change distinct properties, and the rod also crafts Wind Charges.
